notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 4 (Coronation, Ulm and Austerlitz): 5 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: medium shot, the First Consul writing at a large desk on the left third, piles of papers and bound volumes, a secretary at a side table
shots.scene: Napoleon as First Consul at work in the Tuileries at night, about 1803, red consular coat, drafts of the Civil Code, maps on the wall
shots.lighting: warm candlelight and a single oil lamp, deep shadows

shots.framing: wide interior of a Gothic cathedral nave, the Emperor in the centre raising a golden laurel crown, the Pope seated to the right, rows of dignitaries
shots.scene: the coronation in Notre-Dame de Paris, 2 December 1804, crimson velvet and ermine robes, Pope Pius VII seated, Josephine kneeling, banners and candles
shots.lighting: golden light through stained glass, candle glow, incense haze

shots.framing: wide coastal panorama from the cliffs, endless rows of tents and huts on the left, troops drilling on the beach, the grey Channel on the right
shots.scene: the camp of Boulogne, 1804-1805, the Army of England, flat-bottomed invasion boats in the harbour, the white cliffs of England faint on the horizon
shots.lighting: breezy grey-blue northern light, scudding clouds

shots.framing: wide seascape at the waterline, two lines of ships of the line in close action, broadsides firing, sails torn
shots.scene: the Battle of Trafalgar, 21 October 1805, British, French and Spanish three-deckers, HMS Victory breaking the line, smoke over a heavy swell
shots.lighting: hazy midday sun through gun smoke, silver light on the sea

shots.framing: very wide shot of a battlefield at sunset, the Emperor and his staff riding along a line of cheering soldiers raising shakos on bayonets
shots.scene: the evening of Austerlitz, 2 December 1805, frozen ponds and villages in the valley, captured standards, smoke thinning over the Pratzen Heights
shots.lighting: low red winter sunset, long blue shadows, frost
